slides.texte_overlay:
7 signs a man was
raised right

1. Greetings.
He says good morning
to the whole room,
not just the boss.

2. Thank-yous.
He thanks the driver,
the cook, the cleaner.
Every time.

3. Questions.
He asks about your day
and listens to the answer.

4. Learning.
He reads, asks, looks things up.
Curiosity was praised at home.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. Learning.
He learns a little every day
on the Sophia app. Curiosity
was praised at home.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. Guests.
He offers a drink
before you sit down.

6. Dishes.
He clears his plate
without being asked.

7. Elders.
He stands up when they enter
and gives up his seat.
